Re: Hernandez - Government Claim [LMR-8864]
1 message

Wed, Jun 17, 2026 at 7:28 PM
To: Bill Seldeen <WSeldeen@lacare.org>

Mr. Seldeen,

I am in receipt of your correspondence regarding the government claim submitted on May 28, 2026.

First, correct your timeline for the official record. Your assertion that the claim was received on June 2, 2026, is factually false. USPS tracking confirms the claim was delivered to your facility and received by your staff on June 1, 2026, at 1:13 PM. The statutory timeline commenced on that exact date. Do not attempt to alter the legal timeline based on when your office chose to verify the receipt.

Second, regarding your request for documentation: the DHCS Conlan claim and the state's routing directive are official inter-agency records. As the state-contracted adjudicating entity, L.A. Care already has constructive possession of this file. I will not duplicate state records to facilitate your internal routing. As noted in my claim, private receipts and superbills will be preserved and produced during formal evidentiary proceedings of litigation, if necessary.

Finally, regarding your renewed offer for a phone call: On March 31, 2026, I issued a formal actual notice directly to L.A. Care's General Counsel, Augustavia Haydel, establishing a "CEASE AND DESIST" regarding telephone harassment. Your continued attempts to solicit phone contact, despite this standing directive, will be ignored. All further communications must be in writing.

Please review your own records. As you know, if it is not in writing, it did not happen.

Regards,

Nicolas Hernandez

On Wed, Jun 17, 2026 at 5:22 PM Bill Seldeen <WSeldeen@lacare.org> wrote:

Hello Mr. Hernandez,

This is Bill Seldeen again, and as you know, I serve as in-house counsel for L.A. Care. I'm reaching out regarding the government claim you submitted on May 28, 2026, received June 2, 2026.

Thank you for your government claim. I acknowledge receipt on behalf of L.A. Care. In the claim, you refer to a reimbursement claim submitted to DHCS Conlan Center, which "directed [the] claim to L.A. Care Health Plan for adjudication" note that supporting documentation is available upon request.

If you are willing, I would ask that you please provide a copy of:

* Your March 27, 2028 claim submitted to the DHCS Conlan Center
* The decision from DHCS directing the claim to L.A. Care for adjudication
* Any other supporting documentation you deem relevant

Finally, I renew my offer to discuss your case in hopes of leading a mutually agreeable resolution. If you reconsider, please let me know a convenient time and the best number at which to reach you. I'm happy to work around your schedule.

Sincerely,

Bill Seldeen
Associate Legal Counsel
L.A. Care Health Plan
